metadata.name: claude-code
metadata.summary: Agentic command-line coding tool that understands codebases and automates development workflows

content.value: Claude Code is an agentic AI coding assistant developed by Anthropic that operates directly inside the terminal. Built on Node.js, it interfaces deeply with local codebases to accelerate software development, troubleshoot issues, and execute tasks using natural language prompts.

The tool bridges command-line interaction with advanced language model reasoning, enabling direct project inspection, intelligent code synthesis, and command orchestration without leaving the development environment.

items.value: Executes routine developer tasks, code refactoring, and file edits through natural language
Analyzes project structures and explains complex code logic directly in the terminal
Automates Git operations and version control workflows directly from the CLI
Supports extensibility via custom plugins, tools, and specialized agents
Provides integrated feedback and error reporting via dedicated in-tool commands
